source_policy_decisions.decision: Treat a defining property separately from an unrelated attribute of the same referent. Keep abstract gender tied to its suffix.
Classify compound and source spelling before suffix. The two special cases in budha and yudha have different bases. Neither licenses a free switch on a single input.
Separate general tva/tal coexistence from the option to retain the independently licensed special affix. Preserve the uninflected PG36 register.
One iman nominative and one accusative despite three contexts. Mallinātha supplies a separate, explicit accusative on the tva stem.
The lexical modes of softness coincide locally on these readings. The verse does not enumerate or select the other affix routes.
The ṣ marker, feminine affix and loss of y give separate decisions. The feminine examples are not evidence that every colour abstract has all genders.
